name: llm-for-zotero
description: AI research agent rooted in your Zotero library
author: Yile Wang

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.workflow.json && npm --prefix packages/claude-bridge run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run check:tool-vocabulary && npm run check:skill-hashes && npm run test:claude-bridge && npm run test:workflow
scripts.test:note-batch-restart: node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --quit && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --first && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --absent && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --changed && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --undo && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --undo-first && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --undo-during-card && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --standalone && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --standalone-undo-first && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --standalone-moved && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --legacy && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --legacy-standalone && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --legacy-standalone-edited && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --legacy-twice && node scripts/run-note-batch-restart-test.mjs --legacy-undo-first
